title: Add webapp template: client package.json
description: Create the client package.json template for the React frontend. Lists all required dependencies including React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, React Router, React Hook Form, Zod, and Tailwind. Dev dependencies include testing tools.
acceptanceCriteria: react and react-dom at version ^19 are listed

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/client/package.json.tmpl with name '{{PROJECT_NAME}}-client', version '0.0.1', private true. Add all runtime dependencies: react, react-dom, @tanstack/react-query, react-router-dom, react-hook-form, zod. Add all devDependencies: typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @types/react, @types/react-dom.
Add scripts: { 'dev': 'vite', 'build': 'tsc -b && vite build', 'preview': 'vite preview', 'test': 'vitest run', 'lint': 'eslint src/' }

steps.description: Verify all required dependencies are present
steps.details: Review the file and confirm all packages from the PRD Section 5.1 are listed with appropriate version ranges (use ^ prefix for minor version compatibility).

technicalNotes: Use ^19, ^7, ^5 etc. for version ranges to allow patch updates while locking major versions
shadcn/ui components are added per-project basis (not in base template) since they're installed via CLI
